scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/web && npm run build:api
scripts.test: npm run db:generate && npm run test --workspace=apps/web && npm run test --workspace=packages/shared && cd apps/api && pytest
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/web && cd apps/api && ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/shared && cd apps/api && mypy app/
